construction.candidate_ordinal_stream: Within each family, consume candidate ordinals from 0 upward without gaps; stop once exactly 250 valid neighborhoods per direction are admitted or ordinal 799 is exhausted. The 800-ordinal per-family budget is hard; no reseeding or budget extension.
construction.candidate_semantics: Frozen family candidate identities and text; new/old labels follow the exact semantic fact transition, never pole, array position, or row order.
construction.candidate_permutation: Synthetic scorer permutation-equivariance sanity test only; output slot is not a scientific factor.
construction.polarity: Both directions are represented in both balanced training and evaluation within every family.
construction.identity_claim: Candidate identity remains nested within family/pole; identity-specific attribution is out of scope.

must_be_disjoint_from: all R3 training occurrences including balanced low-to-high SHAM variants
freshness.comparison: Exact field-wise identity set membership; no fuzzy or semantic similarity.
freshness.training_identity_extension: For each R3 low-to-high reverse-SHAM occurrence, world_id/root_id bind to its exact low-pole source episode, episode_id is the emitted r3-low-sham:<source_episode_id>, full_rendered_input_hash is SHA-256 of the exact emitted bytes, and selector_input_hash is the bound same-neighborhood training SHAM selector identity.
freshness.exclusion_set_schema: jev-v08q-r3-field-exclusion-domain-hash-sets-v02; includes Q-R2 panel identities and every R3 training occurrence identity before candidate generation.
freshness.candidate_stream: One new versioned partition/namespace, prospectively fixed 64-bit seed, fixed maximum candidate ordinal per family, no reseeding or budget extension after observed rejections.
freshness.admission: Construct both view identities, reject whole neighborhood before admission if any of the five field values collides with any exclusion set or an already admitted neighborhood; apply the sealed E1 neighborhood-ID hash denylist as a separate exact-identity condition.
freshness.failure: Budget exhaustion or disagreement between online admission receipts and final whole-panel audit makes the panel non-promotable; no hand repair or regeneration under this identity.
